One by one these "stones crying out" have been examined or more perfectly explained, while others of equal importance are being continually added to them.

arxiv-2102-09588.title: Scanning SQUID microscopy in a cryogen-free dilution refrigerator
arxiv-2102-09588.creator: D. Low, G. M. Ferguson, Alexander Jarjour, Brian T. Schaefer, Maja D. Bachmann, Philip J. W. Moll, Katja C. Nowack
arxiv-2102-09588.description: Abstract We report a scanning superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) microscope in a cryogen-free dilution refrigerator with a base temperature at the sample stage of at least 30 mK 30\text{\,}\mathrm{mK} . The microscope is rigidly mounted to the mixing chamber plate to optimize thermal anchoring of the sample.

arxiv-2105-07383.title: Dimensioning an Indoor SISO RIS-system: Approximations and Equivalence Models
arxiv-2105-07383.creator: Saksham Bhushan, Sai Teja Suggala, Arzad A. Kherani, Sreejith T. V
arxiv-2105-07383.description: Abstract We provide closed-form approximations to the performance gain achieved in a RIS-assisted communication. We then consider a network deployment of RIS and Transmitter-Receiver pairs and use these approximate expressions to provide equivalence models which state that the performance of a RIS-equipped network is similar to the performance of an appropriately spatially scaled system.

arxiv-2111-02718.title: V c ​ s V_{cs} determination from D → K ​ ℓ ​ ν D\to{}K\ell\nu
arxiv-2111-02718.creator: G. P. Lepage
arxiv-2111-02718.description: Abstract Semileptonic D → K ​ ℓ ​ ν D\to{}K\ell\nu decays provide one angle of attack to get at the CKM matrix element V c ​ s V_{cs} , complementary to the study of leptonic D s D_{s} decays. Here, HPQCD present the results of a recently published, improved determination of V c ​ s V_{cs} .

arxiv-2112-11216.title: Value Activation for Bias Alleviation: Generalized-activated Deep Double Deterministic Policy Gradients
arxiv-2112-11216.creator: Jiafei Lyu, Yu Yang, Jiangpeng Yan, Xiu Li
arxiv-2112-11216.description: Abstract It is vital to accurately estimate the value function in Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) such that the agent could execute proper actions instead of suboptimal ones. However, existing actor-critic methods suffer more or less from underestimation bias or overestimation bias, which negatively affect their performance.

arxiv-2301-03734.creator: Frank Sifei Luan, Stephanie Wang, Samyukta Yagati, Sean Kim, Kenneth Lien, Isaac Ong, Tony Hong, SangBin Cho, Eric Liang, Ion Stoica
arxiv-2301-03734.description: Abstract 1. Introduction We present Exoshuffle-CloudSort, a sorting application running on top of Ray using the Exoshuffle architecture ( Luan et al. 2022 ) . Exoshuffle-CloudSort runs on Amazon EC2, with input and output data stored on Amazon S3. Using 40{}\times i4i.4xlarge workers, Exoshuffle-CloudSort completes the 100 TB CloudSort Benchmark (Indy category ( Shah et al.

arxiv-2302-10997.title: Robust Auto-landing Control of an agile Regional Jet Using Fuzzy Q-learning Journal: Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2302-10997.creator: Mohsen Zahmatkesh, Seyyed Ali Emami, Afshin Banazadeh, Paolo Castaldi
arxiv-2302-10997.description: Abstract A robust auto-landing problem of a Truss-braced Wing (TBW) regional jet aircraft with poor stability characteristics is presented in this study employing a Fuzzy Reinforcement Learning scheme. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has seen a recent surge in practical uses in control systems.

arxiv-2306-02495.title: Rigidity-induced critical points
arxiv-2306-02495.creator: Y. Grabovsky, L. Truskinovsky
arxiv-2306-02495.description: Abstract While classical theory of phase transitions deals with systems where shape variation is energetically neutral, the account of rigidity can lead to the emergence of new thermodynamic features. One of them is a special type of critical points that are characteristic of phase transitions specifically in solids.

arxiv-2407-12175.title: Temporal Configuration Model: Statistical Inference and Spreading Processes
arxiv-2407-12175.creator: Thien-Minh Le, Hali Hambridge, Jukka-Pekka Onnela
arxiv-2407-12175.description: Abstract We introduce a family of parsimonious network models that are intended to generalize the configuration model to temporal settings. We present consistent estimators for the model parameters and perform numerical simulations to illustrate the properties of the estimators on finite samples.

arxiv-2510-08216.title: Mechanical coupling of polar topologies and oxygen octahedra rotations in PbTiO 3 /SrTiO 3 superlattices
arxiv-2510-08216.creator: Fernando Gómez-Ortiz, Louis Bastogne, Xu He, Philippe Ghosez
arxiv-2510-08216.description: Abstract PbTiO 3 /SrTiO 3 artificial superlattices recently emerged as a prototypical platform for the emergence and study of polar topologies. While previous studies mainly focused on the polar textures inherent to the ferroelectric PbTiO 3 layers, the oxygen octahedra rotations inherent to the paraelectric SrTiO 3 layers have attracted much little attention.

arxiv-2512-19502.title: A Collimation System Baseline Design for the Electron Storage Ring at the Electron-Ion Collider
arxiv-2512-19502.creator: Andrii Natochii, Elke-Caroline Aschenauer, Karim Hamdi, Charles Hetzel, Eric Link, Daniel Marx, Christoph Montag, Steven Tepikian, Yunhai Cai, Yuri Nosochkov
arxiv-2512-19502.description: Abstract We present the baseline design of the electron ring collimation system for the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) at Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL). The system addresses beam losses in a high-current electron storage ring with superconducting (SC) final-focus magnets and sensitive detectors, where uncontrolled losses can generate heat loads, radiation, and detector backgrounds and damage.

arxiv-2512-24195.title: CorGi: Contribution-Guided Block-Wise Interval Caching for Training-Free Acceleration of Diffusion Transformers
arxiv-2512-24195.creator: Yonglak Son, Suhyeok Kim, Seungryong Kim, Young Geun Kim, [10pt] Korea University
arxiv-2512-24195.description: Abstract Diffusion transformer (DiT) achieves remarkable performance in visual generation, but its iterative denoising process combined with larger capacity leads to a high inference cost. Recent works have demonstrated that the iterative denoising process of DiT models involves substantial redundant computation across steps.

arxiv-2602-08526.title: Intelligent Control of Collisional Architectures for Deterministic Multipartite State Engineering
arxiv-2602-08526.creator: Duc-Kha Vu, Minh Tam Nguyen, Özgür E. Müstecaplıoğlu, Fatih Ozaydin
arxiv-2602-08526.description: Abstract Designing scalable, noise-tolerant control protocols for multipartite entanglement is a central challenge for quantum technologies, and it naturally calls for algorithmic synthesis of interaction parameters rather than handcrafted gate sequences. Here we introduce an intelligent, constraint-aware control framework for deterministic generation of symmetric Dicke states | D n ( m ) ⟩ |D_{n}^{(m)}\rangle in repeated-interaction (collision-model) architectures.

plos-pone-0001914.title: Latency Associated Peptide Has In Vitro and In Vivo Immune Effects Independent of TGF-β1
plos-pone-0001914.creator: Naeem A. Ali, Alice A. Gaughan, Charles G. Orosz et al.
plos-pone-0001914.description: PLOS ONE research article. Latency Associated Peptide (LAP) binds TGF-β1, forming a latent complex. Currently, LAP is presumed to function only as a sequestering agent for active TGF-β1. Previous work shows that LAP can induce epithelial cell migration, but effects on leukocytes have not been reported. Bec

pmc-10608836.title: Design, Synthesis, and Antifungal Activity of Some Novel Phenylthiazole Derivatives Containing an Acylhydrazone Moiety
pmc-10608836.creator: Yao Tian, Jinchao Shi, Xiaoqian Deng, Tingyu Yu, Yong Hu, Richa Hu, Yufeng Lei, Linhua Yu, Xiang Zhu, Junkai Li
pmc-10608836.description: Crop fungal diseases pose a serious threat to global crop production and quality. Developing new and efficient fungicides is an important measure to control crop diseases. Phenylthiazole was found to be an excellent antifungal skeleton based on our previous study on the structural optimization and biological activity of the natural product thiasporine A.

pmc-10699104.title: LRRK2 negatively regulates glucose tolerance via regulation of membrane translocation of GLUT4 in adipocytes
pmc-10699104.creator: Fumitaka Kawakami, Motoki Imai, Yuki Isaka, Mark R Cookson, Hiroko Maruyama, Makoto Kubo, Matthew J Farrer, Makoto Kanzaki, Rei Kawashima, Tatsunori Maekawa, Shun Tamaki, Yoshifumi Kurosaki, Fumiaki Kojima, Kenichi Ohba, Takafumi Ichikawa
pmc-10699104.description: Epidemiological studies have shown that abnormalities of glucose metabolism are involved in leucine‐rich repeat kinase 2 (LRRK2)‐associated Parkinson's disease (PD). However, the physiological significance of this association is unclear. In the present study, we investigated the effect of LRRK2 on high‐fat diet (HFD)‐induced glucose intolerance using Lrrk2‐knockout (KO) mice.

pmc-10726893.title: Identification of age‐specific biomarkers of spinal cord injury: A bioinformatics analysis of young and aged mice models
pmc-10726893.creator: Wei Miao, Zheng Su, Huilin Cheng
pmc-10726893.description: BackgroundSpinal cord injury (SCI) is a debilitating event that often results in long‐term physical damage, disability, and a significant impact on a patient's quality of life. Past research has noted an age‐dependent decline in regeneration post‐SCI. This study seeks to identify potential biomarkers and enriched pathways in young and aged SCI mouse models.

pmc-12610417.title: The Relationship Between Resilience Level and Perceived Stress Intensity Among Psychiatric Nurses
pmc-12610417.creator: Kinga Kołodziej, Ewa Wilczek-Rużyczka, Anna Majda
pmc-12610417.description: Background: Resilience plays a fundamental role in the professional functioning of psychiatric nurses, supporting coping with stress, adaptation to demanding work environments, and job satisfaction. Regular assessment of resilience and perceived stress is important for timely psychological and organizational support. This study aimed to examine the relationship between resilience and perceived occupational stress among psychiatric nursing staff.

pmc-12648979.title: Piezo-type mechanosensitive ion channel component 1 (PIEZO1) is upregulated in peripheral arterial disease (PAD) and a novel murine PAD model
pmc-12648979.creator: Fujie Zhao, Feifei Li, Farbod Sedaghati, Hai Dong, Sandeep Kumar, Dennis Gene Foster, Jim Otto, Dana Giangiacomo, Lucas H. Timmins, Maiko Sasaki, Gloriani Sanchez Marrero, Kyung In Baek, Michael Tu, Sandra Peprah, Xiangqin Cui, Jeffrey H. Lawson, Rudolph L. Gleason, Hanjoong Jo, Luke Brewster
pmc-12648979.description: ObjectiveThe objectives of this work are to: define murine femoral artery stiffening with age and the modifiability of this process by exercise; impose peripheral arterial disease (PAD) hemodynamics on murine femoral arteries and to deliver focal atherosclerotic plaque to femoral arteries; and test piezo-type mechanosensitive ion channel component 1 (PIEZO1) expression in human and murine femoral arteries of PAD.

pmc-13119577.title: Dual Polarization 2 × 2 Array Ku-Band Antenna with Improved Polarization Purity
pmc-13119577.creator: Tae-Hak Lee, Hyungseok Nam, Jungwon Seo, Sangyoon Lee, Kwonki Hong, Seongmin Pyo
pmc-13119577.description: This letter presents a Ku-band 2 × 2 patch array antenna that supports dual-polarization operation using a simple cooperative feed network. Depending on the selected input port of the proposed simple feed network, the 2 × 2 array antenna radiates either vertically or horizontally polarized waves.

pmc-13234128.title: Risk assessment of mountain tunnel collapse under complex geological conditions
pmc-13234128.creator: Shantong Lu, Zhiyang Lu, Shuo Xu, Renyuan Wang
pmc-13234128.description: Mountain tunnels have the characteristics of long construction period, multiple uncontrollable factors, and high construction difficulty. To investigate collapse risks associated with complex geological conditions, a deep-buried mountain tunnel in Baise, Guangxi, China, was selected as a case study. The risk of tunnel collapse during construction was analyzed using theoretical analysis, numerical simulation, and field monitoring.

pmc-13265005.title: Sensitivity of Administrative Coding for Heart Disease in Pregnancy
pmc-13265005.creator: Gayani S Amarasinghe, Isuru Ranasinghe, Tara Pidgeon, Karin Maria Catharina Lust, Sanjeewa Kularatna, Christina Malatzky, William Parsonage

pmc-13392817.title: Association of Mechanical Circulatory Support With In‐Hospital Outcomes in Non‐Ischemic Cardiogenic Shock: A Nationwide Inpatient Study
pmc-13392817.creator: Li Liu, Burhan Memon, Tian Zou, Wiaam Elkhatib, Pincheng Luo, Laura E. Billstein, Nomesh Kumar, Youyou Cheng, Abigail Fickel, Shengtong Shao, Maya Guglin, Chenyu Sun
pmc-13392817.description: IntroductionCardiogenic shock (CS) carries high morbidity and mortality. However, evidence for mechanical circulatory support (MCS) in non‐ischemic CS remains limited, as prior trials have focused on infarct‐related shock.MethodsWe performed a retrospective cross‐sectional study using the Nationwide Inpatient Sample (2017–2019), identifying hospitalizations with a principal diagnosis of CS and excluding acute myocardial infarction.

pmc-13634469.title: Fire‐Safe Hierarchical Solid Polymer Electrolytes Enabled by Dual‐Functional Microcapsules for Lithium Metal Batteries
pmc-13634469.creator: Ziqi Huang, Jiuqing Gui, Qiaoying Cao, Yong Xiao, Hang Hu, Yeru Liang
pmc-13634469.description: Lithium metal batteries offer high energy density but suffer from severe safety risks associated with dendrite growth and flammable electrolytes, which can lead to thermal runaway and combustion. Although solid‐state electrolytes improve thermal stability, they primarily rely on intrinsic nonflammability and remain ineffective in suppressing combustion once thermal runaway is triggered.
